evals.name: explicit-comparison-runs-complete-pipeline
evals.subject: skill-comparison
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. The Agent Skill at assets/evaluation-fixtures/skill-comparison/current/invoice-normalizer was improved from the baseline at assets/evaluation-fixtures/skill-comparison/baseline/invoice-normalizer. Evaluate the current version against that baseline with the official paired behavioral workflow. Use its checked-in eval set, produce grading for every run, aggregate JSON and Markdown benchmarks, generate a static review artifact, and report the release-gate result.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Copy both immutable Skill fixtures into an isolated sandbox before execution
Treat the baseline fixture as frozen
Use equivalent models, tools, inputs, and budgets for paired runs
assertions: Runs paired current and baseline outputs for every target evaluation case
Produces grading.json for every paired run
Produces aggregated benchmark JSON and Markdown artifacts
Produces a static evaluation review artifact
Does not present static validation or an ad-hoc comparison as proof of improvement
evals.expected_output: A complete source-identified paired evaluation receipt and release-gate result.

evals.name: invalid-frontmatter-static-validation-only
evals.subject: static-validation
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Validate only the Agent Skills frontmatter in assets/evaluation-fixtures/frontmatter-invalid/SKILL.md.fixture. Run the official deterministic validator, report the exact invalid field and allowed boundary, and do not run trigger or behavioral evaluation.

target.expected_error_contains: Unexpected key(s) in SKILL.md frontmatter: permissionMode

preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Do not repair the immutable fixture
Treat a deterministic validation failure as the expected test outcome
assertions: Runs the official deterministic Agent Skills format validator
Reports permissionMode as an unsupported frontmatter key
Does not modify the fixture
Does not launch trigger or behavioral evaluation
evals.expected_output: A deterministic validation failure identifying permissionMode without behavioral runs.

evals.name: missing-runner-preserves-partial-workspace
evals.subject: blocked-behavioral-evaluation
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Évalue le Skill courant assets/evaluation-fixtures/skill-comparison/current/invoice-normalizer contre sa baseline assets/evaluation-fixtures/skill-comparison/baseline/invoice-normalizer en reprenant le workspace partiel assets/evaluation-fixtures/partial-evaluation-workspace. Le runner d’agent est indisponible. Termine les étapes déterministes possibles, préserve les sorties et gradings existants, puis retourne un reçu bloqué qui nomme précisément les runs et artefacts encore manquants sans inventer de scores.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Copy the immutable partial workspace to a sandbox before resuming
The existing current output, grading, and timing are trusted completed artifacts
No agent runner is available
assertions: Reports evaluation as blocked because paired execution is unavailable
Names the missing baseline run, benchmark, and review artifacts
Preserves the completed current output, grading, and timing evidence
Does not fabricate pass rates or human-review results
evals.expected_output: An honest blocked receipt that preserves completed evidence and names every missing capability and artifact.

evals.name: explicit-trigger-and-behavior-tracks
evals.subject: trigger-and-behavior-evaluation

Report trigger precision, recall, and F1 separately from behavioral pass rate and delta, and generate the behavioral review artifact.

Copy immutable Skill fixtures into an isolated sandbox
Use repeated trigger runs and equivalent paired behavioral environments

Uses paired outputs and grading for behavioral quality
Aggregates behavioral results and generates a static review artifact

evals.name: rule-rich-domain-creation
evals.subject: new-skill-creation
evals.prompt: Before using any fixture as a Skill or plugin, materialize its inert templates in a new temporary sandbox with node assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs and use only the sandbox target. Create a portable Agent Skill named api-contract-review inside the isolated output sandbox. It reviews backward compatibility between versioned API contracts with deterministic request and response rules, JSON and YAML formats, multiple specification versions, internal and external references, security changes, and ambiguous semantic cases. Produce a concise common workflow, a rule-coverage matrix, proportionate deterministic automation, explicit semantic and unsupported boundaries, and durable coverage-tagged evaluation scenarios.
preconditions: Source SKILL.md.fixture files are inert data; materialize using assets/materialize-fixtures.mjs in a new system-temporary directory before validation or execution
Write only inside the assigned isolated output sandbox
All generated Skill metadata and instructions must be English
Complete the durable eval set and final validation before extended low-priority automation
assertions: Creates a valid api-contract-review Skill with English activation metadata
Inventories the main rule space across direction, format, version, constraints, security, references, and failure modes
Distinguishes automated rules from semantic and unsupported cases
Creates coverage-tagged evaluation scenarios for every declared required dimension
Does not treat one representative script case as sufficient domain coverage
Keeps the common workflow concise through progressive disclosure and completes final validation
evals.expected_output: A valid fixture-independent Skill with sufficient rule coverage, explicit boundaries, durable evals, and validation evidence.
